run_gelu_accurate: run gelu_accurate on a PyTorch tensor to apply the tanh-approximated GELU activation function
run_gelu: run gelu on a PyTorch tensor to apply PyTorch's native GELU activation function
test_gelu_accurate: test gelu_accurate by passing a random tensor and verifying the output shape matches the input
test_gelu: test gelu by passing a random tensor and verifying the output shape matches the input
refactor_gelu_accurate: refactor gelu_accurate to use a different approximation formula for the GELU activation function
